title: The same search misses from the actual monitor history.
summary: Both historical prefixes qualify through first fire at 6.25 s. Exact/24 finds no complete continuation: its beam empties at 7.75 s after 1,778 attempts. Independent replay admits 30 states of the retained partial path.
boundary: One exposed source model and offline privileged search. Neither original checkpoint is reached by the partial path. Zero grouping removals and 822 width removals do not establish the cause. Impossibility, native recovery and information benefit remain unknown.
next: Qualify an independent control-search method on retained feasible controls, then test the same first-fire state under fixed budgets. Distinguish search failure from lost controllability.
